title: THEY WILL SHARE IT WITH YOU

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every
difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will
make your load lighter, because they will share it with you."
- Ex 18:22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Notice the balance in this arrangement. It is not all or nothing.

Moses does not stop judging. He stops judging everything. The difficult cases
still come to him; the straightforward ones do not. That is thoughtful
delegation, not abandonment.

Notice the phrase at the end: "they will share it with you." Not take it from
you. Share it. The load remains real; it is simply distributed.

This is how the New Testament describes the church. Paul writes that the whole
body "grows and builds itself up in love, as each part does its work" (Eph
4:16). Each part. Not the pastor doing everything while everyone watches.

There is something in this for both sides. For those who carry too much: sharing
the load is not a failure of dedication. For those who carry too little: someone
near you is exhausted, and there is probably a simple case you could handle.

Many churches and families have one person doing far too much and several people
willing to help who have never been asked. Jethro's solution required Moses to
ask.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you carrying something you have never asked for help with?
2. Is there a "simple case" near you that you could take off someone's hands?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, teach me both to ask for help and to offer it. Let the load be shared as
You intended. Amen.
